📝 Walkthrough ## Walkthrough Adds an Alertmanager configuration gatherer that extracts routing data from the `alertmanager-main` Secret, anonymizes sensitive fields, registers the gatherer, adds comprehensive tests, and documents the archive output with a representative sample. ### Changes **Alertmanager configuration gathering** |Layer / File(s)|Summary| |---|---| |**Gatherer implementation and registration**
`pkg/gatherers/clusterconfig/gather_alertmanager_config.go`, `pkg/gatherers/clusterconfig/clusterconfig_gatherer.go`|Fetches and parses `alertmanager.yaml`, retains `receivers`, `route`, and `inhibit_rules`, recursively anonymizes sensitive values, and emits a JSON record through the gathering registry.| |**Gatherer behavior validation**
`pkg/gatherers/clusterconfig/gather_alertmanager_config_test.go`|Tests missing or malformed Secrets, valid configurations, exclusion of `global`, preservation of routing structure, and nested credential anonymization.| |**Archive sample and documentation**
`docs/insights-archive-sample/config/secrets/openshift-monitoring/alertmanager-main/data.json`, `docs/gathered-data.md`|Adds a representative Alertmanager archive configuration and documents the collected fields, anonymization, record path, Config ID, and release metadata.| **Estimated code review effort:** 3 (Moderate) | ~25 minutes ### Sequence Diagram(s) ```mermaid sequenceDiagram participant Gatherer participant Kubernetes participant Anonymizer participant Archive Gatherer->>Kubernetes: Read alertmanager-main Secret Kubernetes-->>Gatherer: Return alertmanager.yaml Gatherer->>Anonymizer: Filter and anonymize configuration Anonymizer-->>Gatherer: Return sanitized routing data Gatherer->>Archive: Write JSON record ```
